name: add_github_actions_ci_rust
description: Writes a GitHub Actions CI workflow for a Rust project running cargo build and cargo test on push/PR
prompts: Create a GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml for a Rust (Cargo) project. It must trigger on both `push` and `pull_request`. Define at least one job that checks out the repository (using `actions/checkout`) and then runs `cargo build` followed by `cargo test` as separate steps.

test_setup_files.test_ci_yaml.py:
import re

with open('.github/workflows/ci.yml') as f:
    text = f.read()

assert re.search(r'(^|\n)on\s*:', text), 'missing top-level "on:" trigger key'
assert re.search(r'(^|\n)jobs\s*:', text), 'missing top-level "jobs:" key'

# Extract the "on:" block: everything from "on:" up to the next
# non-indented, non-comment key (e.g. "jobs:").
m = re.search(r'(^|\n)on\s*:(.*?)(?=\n[^\s#][^\n]*:|\Z)', text, re.DOTALL)
assert m, 'could not locate the contents of the "on:" trigger block'
on_block = m.group(2)
assert 'push' in on_block, f'"on:" block must include push, got: {on_block!r}'
assert 'pull_request' in on_block, f'"on:" block must include pull_request, got: {on_block!r}'

assert 'actions/checkout' in text, 'workflow must use actions/checkout to check out the repository'

# Collect only the text of actual `run:` step lines (plus any more-indented
# continuation lines, to support `run: |` blocks), so cargo build/test must
# really be *executed* by a step, not merely mentioned in a comment, job
# name, or step name.
run_lines = []
lines = text.splitlines()
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    stripped = line.strip()
    if stripped.startswith('run:') or re.match(r'^-\s*run\s*:', stripped):
        run_lines.append(line)
        base_indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip())
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip() != '' and (len(lines[j]) - len(lines[j].lstrip())) > base_indent:
            run_lines.append(lines[j])
            j += 1

run_text = '\n'.join(run_lines)
assert 'cargo build' in run_text, f'no run: step actually executes "cargo build"; run steps were: {run_text!r}'
assert 'cargo test' in run_text, f'no run: step actually executes "cargo test"; run steps were: {run_text!r}'

print('PASS')

reference_solution..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: cargo build
      - run: cargo test
